correctness.rationale: The finite common-set circumcenter has active contact barycentric weights. The weighted squared-distance identity constrains centers of both minimum covering balls; the optimal two-ball cover and Jensen concavity prove \(R(A\cup B)\le s+\sqrt{s^2-r^2}\). Cauchy--Schwarz gives the universal sharp \((1+\sqrt2)/2\) factor. Four planar points give equality exactly for \(s=\sqrt2,r=1\); other planar four/three point sets attain the full two-parameter envelope. Degenerate and one-dimensional cases were handled. The standard-library verifier checked 1,752 random finite-set samples plus two witnesses; no infinite inference rests on those tests.
